title: Finite global generators for an invertible module
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and $L$ an invertible $X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. If $L$ admits generating sections [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections], then it admits a generating family whose index type is finite.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AO (tensor generation); Varieties, Tag 09NC (quasi-compact selection)

proof.text: Use lem-sc-finite-sections-cover-qc to choose t indexed by Fin m with nonvanishing loci covering X. Extend to Fin(m+1) by adding the zero section and lift indices to the sheaf universe. Construct compatible global sections by restricting each top-open section. The original t values occur at castSucc indices. The fibre criterion lem-weil-pbc-invertible-generating-sections-fibre therefore proves the new finite family generates. This works also for m=0 on the empty scheme.
